'''Rakesh Kumar Mishra''' is an Indian scientist specializing in [[genomics]] and [[epigenetics]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.insaindia.res.in/pdf/YearBook_2016.pdf |title=Archived copy |access-date=2 November 2016 |archive-date=4 November 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161104001952/http://www.insaindia.res.in/pdf/YearBook_2016.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref> He is currently the Director of [https://tigs.res.in/ Tata Institute for Genetics and Society (TIGS)], Bengaluru. Dr. Mishra retired as the 6th director of [[CCMB|CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology]] (CCMB) in [[Hyderabad]], India,<ref name="TheHindu">{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/rakesh-kumar-mishra-appointed-as-ccmb-director/article8620250.ece|title=Rakesh Kumar Mishra appointed as CCMB director|first=M.|last=Somasekhar|website=@businessline|date=19 May 2016 }}</ref> on 30 April 2021 and holds J. C. Bose Fellowship at CCMB.

==Biography==
He is an elected fellow of the [[Indian National Science Academy|Indian National Academy of Science]], New Delhi,<ref>{{cite news | url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/home/science/CCMB-research-finds-B12-deficiency-leads-to-low-birth-weight/articleshow/44960377.cms | title=CCMB research finds B12 deficiency leads to low birth weight | date=28 October 2014 | newspaper=The Times of India | first=Ch Sushil | last=Rao | access-date=21 March 2019 }}</ref> the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]], the [[National Academy of Sciences]] and the [[Andhra Pradesh Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Bio" />

He is also a life member of [[Proteomics Society, India]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.psindia.org/members.html|title=List of Proteomics Society (India) Members|access-date=2 November 2016|website=Proteomics Society, India}}</ref> Mishra obtained his master's degree in chemistry<ref name="Bio">{{cite news |author=News Desk |title=Dr Rakesh Mishra appointed as the new Director of CCMB, Hyderabad |url=https://www.biovoicenews.com/dr-rakesh-kumar-mishra-appointed-director-centre-cellular-molecular-biology/ |work=BioVoiceNews |date=21 May 2016}}</ref> and Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry<ref name="Bio" /> from the [[University of Allahabad]] and was appointed Director CCMB by CSIR, assuming charge on 19 May 2016.<ref name="TheHindu" /> Mishra has also edited and contributed a chapter to the book, [[Chromosomes to Genome]].<ref>{{Cite book | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=39Yh3iclF7IC&q=chromosomes+to+genome | title=Chromosomes to Genome| isbn=9789380026213| last1=Mishra| first1=Rakesh K.| date=30 December 2013| publisher=I. K. International Pvt}}</ref>

Mishra had previously held [[Postdoctoral researcher|post doctoral]] positions at the [[Molecular Biophysics Unit]], [[Indian Institute of Science]], Bangalore, [[University of Bordeaux]], France and [[University of Geneva]], Switzerland prior to joining [[CCMB|CSIR-CCMB]] in 2001.<ref name="Bio" />

==Research interests==
Mishra investigates genome organisation focusing on evolutionarily conserved regions, structure of [[chromatin]] material and [[epigenetic regulation]] of genes during embryonic development stages.<ref name="TheHindu" />

== As a director of CCMB ==
Mishra assumed charge of CCMB on 19 May 2016. Some of the hallmark initiatives that he started in CCMB include:

* CCMB's efforts in developing lab-grown meat<ref>{{cite news | url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/food/hsi/india-ccmb-join-hands-to-promote-lab-grown-meat/articleshow/63528027.cms?from=mdr | title=HSI/India, CCMB join hands to promote lab-grown meat | newspaper=The Economic Times | date=29 March 2018 }}</ref>
* CCMB's fight against COVID-19<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.biovoicenews.com/covid-19-ccmb-hyderabad-engages-on-multiple-fronts-to-develop-solutions/ | title=COVID-19: CCMB Hyderabad engages on multiple fronts to develop solutions | date=13 April 2020 }}</ref>
